newsitem.title: USA: Marks Bros files for 2.33 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Marks Bros files for 2.33 million shares.

text.p: Marks Bros Jewelers said Thursday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 2,330,000 common shares.

Of the total amount, the company is selling 1,100,000 common shares while certain shareholders are offering 1,230,000 common shares. After the offering there will be 9,707,250 common shares outstanding.
The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option of up to 349,500 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Montgomery Securities and William Blair & Co, the filing said.
Net proceeds will be used to reduce indebtedness, accelerate new store openings and for working capital and other general corporate purposes, it said.
